children: Cathay Pacific said passenger flights to and from Dubai and Riyadh will remain cancelled until November 30, 2026, as it responds to the latest developments in the Middle East, according to ETNet.

Affected passengers may rebook, change destinations or request refunds. Cathay Cargo will also continue to review when it can resume freighter services to Dubai and Riyadh. The airline said it will keep closely monitoring the situation in the Middle East.

title: Cathay Pacific Cancels Dubai And Riyadh Passenger Flights Until November 30, 2026
